source.title: Niger government launch of AES biometric national identity card

national_identity_card_number.notes: Official government material confirms the biometric national identity card program, but no public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. Runtime no longer prefixes the generated value with CNI because no source confirms that the document label is part of the number.
